title: proof coverage keys a proof's PROVES on outcome numbers as on clause numbers
intention: proof_coverage reads the keys a proof's PROVES must cover, and the decisions' writes, through the plan view, so an outcomes ticket's keys are its outcomes' n.
why: Measured 2026-11-14: Q#100 is answered and the plan becomes outcomes (outline 9.3.5.1.2.1); this component reads ticket plans, so by RULE 1 its dual-read is its own ticket, a sibling of aa3e9a70db47 (the migration).
traces_to: Law 5 (the plan carries what a builder needs now), RULE 1 (each reader changes inside its own component); outline 9.3.5.1.2.1.
how: Dual-read during the change: compose base's published plan view (5c1e0a7d93b2); after: 5c1e0a7d93b2.

clauses.claim: an outcomes ticket's PROVES keys are the n of its outcomes with a claim, and its writes set is the union of the outcomes' writes_to
a clauses+decisions ticket's keys and writes are unchanged from main

decisions.text: D1: proof_coverage's decisions read (~line 163) iterates plan.steps(ticket) and its clause keys (~line 184) are the n of plan.clauses(ticket). It composes cairn.tools.base.plan (ticket 5c1e0a7d93b2): clauses(doc) gives [{n, claim}] from outcomes that carry a claim, else falsifier.clauses; steps(doc) gives [{n, text, writes_to, reads, after}] from outcomes (text = claim, else the migrated text), else decisions; it keeps no second reading of either shape.
D2: the red-first proof feeds the reader one ticket in each shape carrying the same content, one tooth per clause.

measured.saw: Akien answered Q#100 (open-7aee6f89e4d9, open-82f27105184f): "rather than tasks should we be focused on outcomes?" ... "yes, we're in agreement. signed -amm". Outline 9.3.5.1.2.1: a plan is constraints, then outcomes {n, claim, writes_to, reads, after, via?}, then resources; the falsifier's clauses merge into the outcomes (old clause n stays outcome n); during the change every reader accepts both shapes, one sibling ticket per reader component.
measured.how: his answer, relayed verbatim by orchestrator; recorded at the question door; outline 9.3.5.1.2.1
